capabilities.feature: YouTube URL and video ingestion
capabilities.notes: Authorized YouTube video and playlist URL flow exists; bare video-ID input remains a minor gap.

capabilities.feature: manual and automatic captions
capabilities.notes: yt-dlp subtitle acquisition, normalization and local parsing are implemented.

capabilities.feature: ASR fallback and explicit ASR
capabilities.notes: TranscriptionProvider abstraction exists, but no functional ASR provider or asynchronous transcription job is enabled yet.

capabilities.feature: uploaded media transcription
capabilities.notes: Add guarded local media import plus an optional functional TranscriptionProvider; signed cloud uploads are not required for local mode.

capabilities.feature: language/source transcript variants and translation
capabilities.notes: Multiple language/source/version variants with provenance and source switching are implemented; translation generation itself is not yet implemented.

capabilities.feature: word timestamps, paragraphs and ASR intelligence
capabilities.notes: Preserve optional word/paragraph structures and provider intelligence without requiring them for local subtitle parsing.

capabilities.feature: persistent searchable transcript library
capabilities.notes: SQLite + FTS5 backed library, Library/Home command center and lesson workspace are implemented.

capabilities.feature: status language and date filters
capabilities.notes: Language/source metadata and course filtering exist; a complete status/language/date faceted filter UI is still missing.

capabilities.feature: transcript deletion and bulk deletion
capabilities.notes: Add explicit metadata/FTS deletion without unexpectedly deleting source media.

capabilities.feature: playlist ingestion
capabilities.notes: yt-dlp playlist archive jobs exist; metadata preview/select parity is not complete.

capabilities.feature: channel resolution with preview selection and limits
capabilities.notes: Channel-wide URLs remain intentionally rejected until preview, selection, limits, rate controls and disk warnings are implemented.

capabilities.feature: synchronized embedded media player and transcript
capabilities.notes: Embedded local media, transcript-to-media seek, media-to-transcript synchronization, active highlighting, auto-scroll, deep links and durable progress are implemented.

capabilities.feature: source/language selector and subtitle customization
capabilities.notes: Transcript source/language variant selection and timestamp/auto-scroll preferences are implemented; full subtitle overlay font/color/position customization is not.

capabilities.feature: editable durable personal notes and bookmarks
capabilities.notes: Durable personal notes, autosave, timestamp bookmarks and viewer source anchors are implemented separately from generated artifacts.

capabilities.feature: structured cited generated notes and summaries
capabilities.notes: Deterministic local cited notes with versioned artifacts and normalized citations are implemented; editable generated-note overlays and richer provider-driven summarization remain.

capabilities.feature: flashcards with timestamp citations
capabilities.notes: Source-cited Q/A cards and reveal UI are implemented; card editing, exports and durable review scheduling remain.

capabilities.feature: spaced repetition and mastery
capabilities.notes: Review rating controls are explicitly visual-only; implement and test SM-2 or FSRS review history, due dates and mastery before claiming this capability.

capabilities.feature: mixed MCQ and short-answer quiz with cited explanations
capabilities.notes: Source-grounded MCQ and short-answer practice is implemented; durable attempts, score history, editing and weak-topic analytics remain.

capabilities.feature: concept map and grounded tutor
capabilities.notes: A lightweight cited concept graph and COURSE_GROUNDED evidence Q&A are implemented; richer graph interaction and optional semantic retrieval remain.

capabilities.feature: transcript TXT JSON SRT VTT export
capabilities.notes: Deterministic TXT/JSON/SRT/VTT exports from normalized transcript segments are implemented.

capabilities.feature: versioned API OpenAPI MCP and automation examples
capabilities.notes: Stable /api/v1 and OpenAPI are implemented; MCP and automation examples remain.

capabilities.feature: credits billing and hosted multi-tenancy
capabilities.notes: The current product is private/local-first; commercial parity must not block the learning product.

capabilities.feature: 18 research tools plus 3 workflow helpers inventory
capabilities.notes: All 21 tool surfaces remain present, with category filters, recent-tool navigation and downloaded-file bridge; scientific fidelity varies by tool.

capabilities.feature: DOM-free reusable computational core and independent numerical validation
capabilities.notes: Extract computations into modules used by UI/tests and add substantive independent reference/golden fixtures.

capabilities.feature: statistics outliers curve fitting error bars molecular MD/HPC BibTeX ISO-4 units and digitizer depth
capabilities.notes: Current Study Lab intentionally implements simplified MVP behavior; close high-value numerical and reproducibility gaps module by module.

capabilities.feature: Course Section Lesson normalized hierarchy
capabilities.notes: Normalized course/section/lesson hierarchy is populated during reconciliation and exposed through the application model.

capabilities.feature: transcript provenance versions and first-class attachments
capabilities.notes: Schema migration supports multiple transcript variants/provenance and indexed attachment metadata while guarded file serving remains the byte boundary.

capabilities.feature: learning library command center and Acquire Learn Work information architecture
capabilities.notes: Course Intelligence OS shell, light/dark themes, Home/Library command center, authorized Acquire flow, Learn workspace, Work/Study Lab, Files and Settings are implemented responsively.

capabilities.feature: versioned backup and import
capabilities.notes: Add metadata backup/import with schema version checks; exclude large media blobs by default.

capabilities.feature: single YouTube URL to MP3 and local download inventory
capabilities.notes: Audio-only MP3 is implemented independently inside the existing authorized Acquire flow. Donor APK source is not public in its repository, so implementation/security parity is not asserted and exact-head CI remains required.

capabilities.feature: video/audio mode and audio format conversion
capabilities.notes: Bounded audio extraction formats are implemented in Course Intelligence; YTSage's richer desktop format-table and multi-audio selection UX are not claimed.

capabilities.feature: SponsorBlock trim speed concurrency containers and audio normalization
capabilities.notes: Server-safe argument mappings and validation exist for the Phase A slice. Runtime media fixtures and exact-head CI evidence remain release gates.

capabilities.feature: preferred subtitle output format
capabilities.notes: SRT/VTT/ASS/LRC preference is wired to yt-dlp. Subtitle burn-in/merging remains outside this slice.

capabilities.feature: playlist selection and export
capabilities.notes: Validated item/range selection is implemented only for explicit YouTube playlist URLs. Rich preview checkbox selection and TXT/CSV/M3U/JSON playlist export remain open.

capabilities.feature: cookies download history metadata thumbnail and dependency readiness
capabilities.notes: Course Intelligence already has browser/cookies.txt auth, durable job history, metadata/description/thumbnail capture and FFmpeg/yt-dlp readiness; UI/packaging differs by design.

capabilities.feature: generic arbitrary-site mode geo-bypass proxy and arbitrary custom yt-dlp commands
capabilities.notes: Course Intelligence keeps an explicit Udemy/YouTube allowlist and authorization-only boundary. Arbitrary-site, geo-restriction-bypass and free-form downloader arguments would weaken SSRF/access-control and command-safety guarantees.

capabilities.feature: localized native desktop installers and in-app component updater
capabilities.notes: The owned product is a Docker-hosted local-first web application rather than a PySide desktop executable. Native packaging is a separate product-strategy choice, not required for media capability parity.
